name: CharityFinancials
shortDescription: A UK charity accounting system from NfP Accountants for separate fund accounts, project costs, reports following the Statement of Recommended Practice (SORP) and church bookkeeping.
suitableContexts: Churches and church charities needing fund and project accounting
Treasurers preparing SORP-aligned reports and ongoing trustee information
Charities that need separate fund, project, donor and location reporting

pricing.summary: CharityFinancials' public website does not publish a current product price or billing model. Request a written quote covering implementation, data migration, user limits, support, VAT, payment frequency, contract term and any accountant-access charges.

tiers.label: CharityFinancials
tiers.detail: No current public product price was found in the reviewed supplier material.

gdprInformation: The marketing site identifies NfP Accountants Ltd as its author and the accountancy firm publishes a general controller privacy notice. The reviewed public material does not establish the product's controller-processor allocation, hosting location, sub-processors, retention, security commitments, data-export process or product-specific DPA. Obtain these in writing before importing donor, supplier, payroll or other personal financial data.
coreFeatures: Fund accounting for restricted, unrestricted, designated and endowment funds
SOFA, Income and Expenditure, Balance Sheet and Trial Balance reports
integrations: Supplier describes direct Making Tax Digital VAT submission as pending HMRC recognition; confirm the live status and supported workflow
No public accounting, banking, payments, payroll or donor-system integration list was found; request current integration documentation
importExport: Supplier describes CSV and Excel bank-transaction imports
Supplier describes PDF and Excel report exports
Request a complete ledger, contact, attachment, audit-trail and configuration export specification before migration
support: Supplier asks prospective organisations to get in touch to start a new organisation
Support channels, response commitments and implementation support require confirmation

uk-operator.value: The CharityFinancials site identifies NfP Accountants Ltd as author. NfP Accountants identifies itself as an English company (08217088) and a London charity-accountancy firm.

church-relevance.value: Supplier says the product is built for UK charities, CIOs, churches and faith organisations, and describes church bookkeeping and financial management.

accounting-scope.value: Supplier documents fund accounting, project costing, SORP-aligned reports, charity financial statements, CSV or Excel bank imports and report exports.

vat-boundary.value: Supplier says its HMRC software-recognition listing is pending and advises alternative VAT-return submission options in the meantime.

editorial.assessment: CharityFinancials is a newer UK charity-accounting option with a credible specialist accountancy supplier and a clearly stated church use case. Its model is focused on accounting dimensions—funds, projects, donors and locations—rather than on a full church-management database. The public product pages describe the accounting workflow well, but material commercial, data-processing, implementation and product-support information is not yet published clearly enough for a low-risk procurement decision without a written supplier pack.
bestFor: Church charities with restricted funds, projects or grant reporting needs
Treasurers who want fund and project reporting to feed management and trustee information
Churches evaluating an accountant-led alternative to general small-business bookkeeping software
strengths: UK charity and church focus stated by the supplier
Fund, project, donor and location dimensions described
SORP-aligned reporting and bank-import workflow documented
Supplier is an established UK charity-accountancy firm
limitations: No current public product price, contract term or user limit found
HMRC recognition for direct Making Tax Digital VAT submission is stated as pending
No public product-specific DPA, hosting-region, sub-processor, security or retention detail found
No detailed public integration, migration, support-service or full-data-export specification found
Not a substitute for a church's own financial controls, independent examination or professional advice

procurementVerdict.problem: Keeping charity funds, projects and reporting coherent without relying on a commercial chart of accounts or year-end spreadsheet reconstruction
procurementVerdict.differentiator: A UK charity-accountant-led platform that treats funds, projects, donors and locations as separate reporting dimensions
procurementVerdict.firstCheck: Ask for a demonstration using a representative restricted-fund and project-reporting scenario, then obtain written price, implementation plan, DPA, hosting and sub-processor information, VAT workflow, exports and support commitments before moving financial records
